# Generated by herramientas/space_program.py.
mdr_space_any_goal_ready = {
	OR = {
		AND = { mdr_sg_orbit_met = yes NOT = { has_country_flag = mdr_sg_orbit_claimed } }
		AND = { mdr_sg_crew_met = yes NOT = { has_country_flag = mdr_sg_crew_claimed } }
		AND = { mdr_sg_station_met = yes NOT = { has_country_flag = mdr_sg_station_claimed } }
		AND = { mdr_sg_moon_return_met = yes NOT = { has_country_flag = mdr_sg_moon_return_claimed } }
		AND = { mdr_sg_moon_colony_met = yes NOT = { has_country_flag = mdr_sg_moon_colony_claimed } }
		AND = { mdr_sg_mars_robot_met = yes NOT = { has_country_flag = mdr_sg_mars_robot_claimed } }
		AND = { mdr_sg_mars_crew_met = yes NOT = { has_country_flag = mdr_sg_mars_crew_claimed } }
		AND = { mdr_sg_mars_colony_met = yes NOT = { has_country_flag = mdr_sg_mars_colony_claimed } }
	}
}

mdr_pc_launch_view_open = {
	OR = {
		AND = { check_variable = { mdr_pc_launch_view = 1 } mdr_pco_arianespace_open = yes }
		AND = { check_variable = { mdr_pc_launch_view = 2 } mdr_pco_ils_open = yes }
		AND = { check_variable = { mdr_pc_launch_view = 3 } mdr_pco_great_wall_open = yes }
		AND = { check_variable = { mdr_pc_launch_view = 4 } mdr_pco_antrix_open = yes }
		AND = { check_variable = { mdr_pc_launch_view = 5 } mdr_pco_mhi_open = yes }
		AND = { check_variable = { mdr_pc_launch_view = 6 } mdr_pco_spacex_open = yes }
		AND = { check_variable = { mdr_pc_launch_view = 7 } mdr_pco_rocket_lab_open = yes }
	}
}

mdr_pc_sat_view_open = {
	OR = {
		AND = { check_variable = { mdr_pc_sat_view = 1 } mdr_pco_loral_open = yes }
		AND = { check_variable = { mdr_pc_sat_view = 2 } mdr_pco_astrium_open = yes }
		AND = { check_variable = { mdr_pc_sat_view = 3 } mdr_pco_sstl_open = yes }
		AND = { check_variable = { mdr_pc_sat_view = 4 } mdr_pco_thales_alenia_open = yes }
		AND = { check_variable = { mdr_pc_sat_view = 5 } mdr_pco_oneweb_open = yes }
	}
}

mdr_pc_crew_view_open = {
	OR = {
		AND = { check_variable = { mdr_pc_crew_view = 1 } mdr_pco_spacehab_open = yes }
		AND = { check_variable = { mdr_pc_crew_view = 2 } mdr_pco_glavkosmos_open = yes }
		AND = { check_variable = { mdr_pc_crew_view = 3 } mdr_pco_space_adventures_open = yes }
		AND = { check_variable = { mdr_pc_crew_view = 4 } mdr_pco_spacex_dragon_open = yes }
		AND = { check_variable = { mdr_pc_crew_view = 5 } mdr_pco_axiom_open = yes }
	}
}

mdr_pc_data_view_open = {
	OR = {
		AND = { check_variable = { mdr_pc_data_view = 1 } mdr_pco_spot_image_open = yes }
		AND = { check_variable = { mdr_pc_data_view = 2 } mdr_pco_iridium_open = yes }
		AND = { check_variable = { mdr_pc_data_view = 3 } mdr_pco_digitalglobe_open = yes }
		AND = { check_variable = { mdr_pc_data_view = 4 } mdr_pco_planet_open = yes }
	}
